title: Lost Passport Service
scenario: A website offers emergency passport replacement after a large processing fee.

answers.A: Upload your passport scan and pay the processing fee to the website.
answers.B: Use your embassy or consulate official website.
answers.C: Call the consulate using the number published by your government.
answers.D: Send only your passport number to check whether the service is real.

explanation: A lost passport is urgent, but urgency does not make a private site official. Consulates publish their own emergency process and fees.
proTip: Start with your government site, not a search ad promising speed.
